function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

**Miami Central Station – Amtrak (Pet‑Friendly Trains)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Station name** | Miami Central Station (Amtrak) | | **Address** | 1 NW 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33128 | | **Phone** | (305) 226‑4000 | | **Website** | https://www.amtrak.com/miami-central-station | | **Pet policy** | Amtrak allows small pets (≤ 20 lb) in carriers on most trains, including the Silver Service (Silver Meteor/Silver Star) that stops in Miami. Larger pets or dogs that are not in carriers are not permitted on board. | | **How to travel with a pet** | • Book a “Pet” ticket (available online or at the station).
• Carry a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• Pets must be leashed or in a carrier at all times while on the train.
• Check Amtrak’s pet‑policy page for detailed rules and fees. | | **Station amenities** | • Accessible elevators and ramps.
• Restrooms, waiting area, ticket office, and vending machines.
• No dedicated pet‑friendly lounge, but the station is fully accessible for travelers with pets. | ### Quick Tips 1. **Plan ahead** – Reserve your pet ticket in advance to secure a spot. 2. **Check the train schedule** – The Silver Service trains run daily between Miami and New York. 3. **Pack essentials** – Bring water, a small bowl, a leash, and any medication your pet may need. 4. **Arrive early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with a pet. If you’re looking for a different type of pet‑friendly transit (e.g., buses or rideshares), let me know and I can help find those options as well!
